title: Honey Bear Under Blood Moon
description: An anthropomorphic black bear with glowing yellow eyes stands centered, wearing a green overcoat with white patterns and red armbands. He holds a dripping golden honey pot in one paw while honey drips from his mouth. A large red blood moon looms behind him against a swirling green cosmic background with floating honey droplets and shell-like patterns.
prompt: Anthropomorphic black bear with glowing golden eyes and a white cross on his forehead, wearing a green patterned overcoat and red armbands, stands dramatically holding a golden honey pot that drips honey.
